name: capability-partner-intro
description: Edanz Japan editorial-partner introduction (Capability series). Fixed-arity: 3 credentials. Numerals 1/2/3 are fixed furniture. Mobile credential card normalised to mirror desktop (separate numeral + title/body widgets per credential).
_notes: Each credential is a single rich_text widget holding a 2-cell table: left cell = marker (number now, icon-ready), right cell = title+body. The marker is layout, not content, so a credential slot's value is the FULL row html (marker + title + body). For clean fills, fill_email_draft should support a per-slot html wrapper (fixed marker cell + a {{content}} placeholder for the right cell), or the caller supplies the wrapped html. Numerals/markers are otherwise fixed furniture.
